display.purpose: Major workspace purpose and page headings.

label.purpose: Coordinates, fields, scope, status, and navigation labels.

shadows.name: entry-ambient
shadows.purpose: Authentication entry surface only; never routine workspace panels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive action with rare Signal Orange emphasis.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.65rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; padding: .68rem 1rem; background: var(--signal, #e55a2f); color: #fff; font: 750 .875rem Geist, sans-serif; transition: background .16s, transform .16s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal-dark, #b94120); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(229,90,47,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Structural secondary action without competing color.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 2.65rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #c9c7bd); border-radius: 0; padding: .68rem 1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #13283d); font: 750 .875rem Geist, sans-serif; transition: background .16s, transform .16s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e5e2d8; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(229,90,47,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square document field with an explicit technical label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .4rem; color: var(--ink, #13283d); font: 700 .875rem Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font: 700 .72rem/1.2 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 2.8rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-dark, #9b9d98); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper-light, #faf8f1); padding: 0 .78rem; color: var(--ink, #13283d); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--signal, #e55a2f); outline: 2px solid rgba(229,90,47,.12); }

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: Flat ruled working surface for a coherent record group.
components.html:
WORKSPACE FILES

Records remain aligned to their company scope.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--line, #c9c7bd); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper-light, #faf8f1); color: var(--ink, #13283d); } .ds-panel header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #c9c7bd); padding: .8rem 1rem; font: 700 .72rem 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; padding: 1.5rem; font: 400 1rem/1.65 Geist, sans-serif; }

components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: Low-noise navigation with a one-pixel active signal.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; padding: .75rem; background: transparent; color: #bfcbd4; font: 600 .82rem Geist, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-active { box-shadow: inset 1px 0 var(--signal, #e55a2f); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(229,90,47,.45); outline-offset: -1px; }

narrative.overview: BEOS treats operational data like a well-kept engineering field ledger: every record has a place, every boundary communicates structure, and emphasis is earned through hierarchy rather than decoration. The interface is precise, calm, operational, and document-grade rather than dashboard-like.
keyCharacteristics: Flat bordered working surfaces with square corners
Large tightly tracked headings paired with technical mono labels
Restrained Signal Orange reserved for action and orientation
Dense enough for real work with generous separation between major regions
Explicit loading, empty, error, denied, and active states

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Signal Orange identifies action or location; it does not become a decorative fill across unrelated regions.

rules.name: Two Voice
rules.body: Sans-serif explains the work; mono labels locate and classify it. Mono is not used for long prose.

rules.name: Flat Working Surface
rules.body: Workspace panels remain flat at rest; interaction is communicated through color, rules, and minimal movement.

dos: Do use persisted product data and truthful empty or unavailable states.
Do align record metadata and actions into ruled registers.
Do reserve Signal Orange for real action, state, and orientation.
Do preserve square controls, visible focus, and readable mobile type.
Do let typography and spacing establish hierarchy before adding chrome.
donts: Don't use rounded SaaS cards, decorative metric grids, floating glass panels, or ornamental dashboard clutter.
Don't invent company metrics, activity, files, notifications, or proof to make an empty surface appear populated.
Don't add shadows to routine workspace panels.
Don't turn every section into an isolated card or every status into a colorful pill.
Don't expose implementation or security mechanics in ordinary product copy.
